# Easy ADB

Easy ADB is a lightweight desktop tool for connecting Android phones, TVs, and TV boxes over USB or Wi-Fi and installing APK files.

## Official links

- Website: https://easyadb.panchan.top/
- Windows and releases: https://github.com/Panda2Chan/easy-adb/releases
- Windows source: https://github.com/Panda2Chan/easy-adb
- macOS source: https://github.com/Panda2Chan/easy-adb-mac

## Features

- USB and Wi-Fi ADB connections
- Wireless pairing with a pairing code
- Local APK drag-and-drop installation
- APK installation from an HTTP or HTTPS download link
- Windows and macOS desktop builds
